plain.li: [feeling:Grief] Some mornings I forget, and then I remember.
[feeling:Grief] I keep turning round to say something to someone who isn't there.
[feeling:Grief,about] {OTHER_nameDef} would have laughed at that.
[feeling:Grief,about] I still look for {OTHER_nameDef} at supper.
[feeling:Grief,child] When is everyone going to stop being sad?
[feeling:Fear] I jump at every noise past the wall.
[feeling:Fear] Every room I walk into, I check where the door is.
[feeling:Fear,!lowtech] I've slept with my rifle in reach all week.
[feeling:Fear,lowtech] There's a knife under my straw now, every night.
[feeling:Fear,night] Leave a light burning tonight, would you?
[feeling:Dread] Something bad is coming, I can feel it in my teeth.
[feeling:Dread] It's too quiet out there.
[feeling:Dread] Any day now, the next thing goes wrong.
[feeling:Anger] Don't talk to me right now.
[feeling:Anger] I'm so angry my jaw hurts.
[feeling:Anger,about] If {OTHER_nameDef} says one more word to me, I'm walking out.
[feeling:Anger,about] I can't even look at {OTHER_nameDef} today.
[feeling:Shame] I can't look anyone in the eye today.
[feeling:Shame] What I did keeps going round and round in my head.
[feeling:Shame] I'll eat on my own tonight.
[feeling:Envy] Must be nice, having what some people have.
[feeling:Envy] Some of us work just as hard and get half as much.
[feeling:Envy,about] {OTHER_nameDef} always seems to get the good end of things.
[feeling:Disgust] I can still smell it on my hands.
[feeling:Disgust] I couldn't eat a thing after seeing that.
[feeling:Disgust] This place needs scrubbing from top to bottom.
[feeling:Loneliness] Two words to me all day, that's all I've had.
[feeling:Loneliness] I could use someone to talk to.
[feeling:Loneliness] People are always too busy to stop and talk.
[feeling:Homesick] The house I grew up in had a blue door, I keep seeing it.
[feeling:Homesick] The bread here never tastes the way it should.
[feeling:Homesick] Back home the river would be up by now.
[feeling:Homesick,night] Same moon as at home, at least.
[feeling:Frustration] Nothing has gone right all day.
[feeling:Frustration] Third time I've had to start this over.
[feeling:Frustration] I asked for one thing, one single thing.
[feeling:Despair] What's the point of any of it?
[feeling:Despair] I'm so tired, and it isn't the work.
[feeling:Despair] I can't see how this gets any better.
[feeling:Joy] What a day.
[feeling:Joy] I could sing, I really could.
[feeling:Joy] Everything's going right for once.
[feeling:Joy,child] This is the best day ever.
[feeling:Pride] I did good work today, and I know it.
[feeling:Pride] They'll be talking about that for a while.
[feeling:Pride,working] Look at that, clean and straight, every bit of it.
[feeling:Love] There's someone I can't stop thinking about.
[feeling:Love,about] I'd walk through fire for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[feeling:Love,about] Have you seen {OTHER_nameDef} this morning?
[feeling:Love,about] {OTHER_nameDef} smiled at me over breakfast.
[feeling:Gratitude] I don't say it enough, but thank you, all of you.
[feeling:Gratitude] I'm lucky to be here with you lot.
[feeling:Gratitude,about] I owe {OTHER_nameDef} more than I can pay back.
[feeling:Hope] Things are turning around, I can feel it.
[feeling:Hope] Next season will be better.
[feeling:Hope,winter] Spring's not far off now.
[feeling:Hope] We might really make something of this place.
[feeling:Awe] I've never seen anything like it.
[feeling:Awe] Makes you feel small, doesn't it?
[feeling:Awe,night] Look at the size of the sky tonight.
[feeling:Contentment] A full belly and a dry bed, what more is there?
[feeling:Contentment] This is a good place.
[feeling:Contentment] I wouldn't change a thing about today.
[feeling:Curiosity] I wonder what's past those hills.
[feeling:Curiosity] How does that work, anyway?
[feeling:Curiosity] I want to take it apart and see what's inside.
[feeling:Curiosity,child] Why is the sky that color?
[feeling:Restless] I can't sit still today.
[feeling:Restless] Same walls, same faces, every day.
[feeling:Restless] Need to get out of here a while, even just to the river and back.
[feeling:Nostalgia] Remember when this was all one room and a fire?
[feeling:Nostalgia] Those first days were hard, but they were good.
[feeling:Nostalgia,old] When I was young we sang on the way to the fields.
[feeling:Relief] I can breathe again.
[feeling:Relief] That was close, too close.
[feeling:Relief] All that worrying, and it came out fine.
[feeling:Tenderness] Someone left a warm cup by my bed this morning.
[feeling:Tenderness,about] I saved the best piece for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[feeling:Tenderness,about] Let {OTHER_nameDef} sleep a bit longer, I'll cover the work.
[feeling:Worry] I hope they're all right out there.
[feeling:Worry] We should check the stores again.
[feeling:Worry,about] Has anyone seen {OTHER_nameDef} today?
[feeling:Worry,about] {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't been right lately, and it's on my mind.
[feeling:Fellowship] We're a good crew, aren't we?
[feeling:Fellowship] I'd trust any of you with my life.
[feeling:Fellowship] Whatever comes over that wall, it'll find all of us waiting.
[feeling:Resolve] We're not going anywhere.
[feeling:Resolve] Let them come.
[feeling:Resolve] I'm going to finish this, whatever it takes.

warm.li: [feeling:Grief] Sit with me a minute, would you?
[feeling:Shame] I'm sorry, all of you, I mean it.
[feeling:Loneliness] Sit with me at supper tonight, if you like.
[feeling:Despair] I'm trying, I really am.
[feeling:Love,about] Make sure {OTHER_nameDef} eats something today.
[feeling:Fellowship] I'm glad it's you lot I ended up with.

blunt.li: [feeling:Grief] Leave me be today.
[feeling:Fear] I'm not scared, just careful.
[feeling:Anger] Back off.
[feeling:Disgust] Filthy, every bit of it.
[feeling:Frustration] Useless, the whole lot of it.
[feeling:Pride] Told you I could do it.
[feeling:Resolve] Back to work, there's no time to waste.

cheerful.li: [feeling:Fear] My hands are shaking, but I'm still standing.
[feeling:Love,about] {OTHER_nameDef} is the best thing that ever happened to me!
[feeling:Fellowship] Best people on this whole rock!
[feeling:Hope] Good things are coming, I just know it.

gloomy.li: [feeling:Grief] Everything here reminds me of what's gone.
[feeling:Dread] We've been lucky, and luck runs out.
[feeling:Loneliness] I could vanish and it'd take them a week to notice.
[feeling:Contentment] I'm almost happy, don't tell anyone.
[feeling:Restless] Another day exactly like the last one.

cold.li: [feeling:Grief] I'll be fine once I stop thinking about it.
[feeling:Joy] A good day, by any measure.
[feeling:Gratitude] I'll repay it, I keep my debts.
[feeling:Curiosity] I want to understand how it was done.
[feeling:Worry] Something's off, and I intend to find out what.

plain.li: [everyday] I'm not quite myself today.
[everyday] Feeling a bit rough, that's all.
[everyday] It's nothing, it'll pass.
[serious] Don't come too close, I'm not well.
[serious] I've never been this sick.
[child,everyday] I don't feel good.
[ail:HeadCold] My nose won't stop running.
[ail:HeadCold] I sound like a goose with this cold.
[ail:StomachBug] Don't talk to me about food.
[ail:ChestCold] Every cough feels like it's tearing something.
[ail:HayFever] It's those flowers again, my eyes are streaming.
[ail:Pinkeye] Don't touch my towel, I've got pinkeye.
[ail:Dreamfever] I'm not sure I'm properly awake right now.
[ail:StrainedBack] Mind my back, it's still out.
[ail:StrainedBack] I can't bend down to tie my own boots.
[ail:SoreHands] My hands won't close properly today.
[ail:Blisters] Every step on these blisters is a new one.
[ail:Chilblains] My toes itch something terrible.
[ail:Sunburn] Don't slap my shoulder, it's burned raw.
[ail:SmokeCough] I can still taste the smoke.
[ail:Toothache] This tooth is driving me out of my mind.
[ail:StiffNeck] I can't turn my head, so come round this side.
[ail:SprainedAnkle] Slow down, I've only got one good ankle.
[ail:EyeStrain] My eyes ache from all the squinting.
[ail:RimrotCough] It's that damp room, it's in my chest now.
[ail:AshLung] I'm still coughing up gray.
[ail:Insomnia] I haven't slept properly in three nights.
[ail:Migraine] Too bright, it's too bright in here.
[ail:Heartburn] I shouldn't have had seconds.
[ail:Nosebleed] Has anyone got a rag, my nose is bleeding again.
[ail:MotionSick] Is the ground still moving, or is it me?
[ail:Splinter] Who's got a needle, there's a splinter in my palm.
[ail:InsectBites] I'm one big itch from head to foot.
[ail:PlantRash] Whatever I pulled up in that row, it bit back.
[ail:Frostnip] I can't feel the tips of my fingers.
[ail:HeatRash] This heat rash is the worst part of summer.
[ail:ColdSore] Use your own cup, I've got a cold sore.
[ail:Lice] Stop looking at my hair.
[ail:AthletesFoot] My feet itch, and you don't want to know more.
[ail:Hiccups] Somebody scare me, I've had hiccups all morning.
[ail:LingeringCough] This cough just won't leave me alone.
[ail:NervePain] There's a burning down my arm where the wound was.
[ail:Tetanus] My jaw won't open properly.
[ail:Pneumonia] I can't get a full breath in.
[ail:Tuberculosis] Keep the little ones away from me.
[ail:Typhus] I'm burning up and I can't stop shaking.
[ail:Meningitis] My neck's stiff and the light hurts my eyes.
[ail:Scurvy] My gums are bleeding again.
[ail:Scurvy] What I'd give for a piece of fresh fruit.
[ail:Glassblood] I bruise if anyone so much as brushes past me.
[ail:Cholera] Water, please, I need water.
[ail:Appendicitis] Something's wrong in my side, low down on the right.
[ail:Rabies] I can't stand the sound of water.
[ail:Measles] I'm spotted all over and burning up.
[ail:KidneyStone] I'd rather break a leg than go through this again.
[ail:Shingles] It's like fire on my skin, all down one side.
[ail:HiveFever] My head's buzzing like a hive.

warm.li: [everyday] I'll be fine, don't fuss over me.
[serious] Thank you for sitting with me.

blunt.li: [everyday] I'm sick, that's all, leave it.
[serious] Just let me sleep.

cheerful.li: [everyday] I'll be right as rain tomorrow!

gloomy.li: [everyday] Of course it had to be me.
[serious] I don't think I'm getting up from this one.

cold.li: [everyday] Keep your distance until it passes.
[serious] Write down what the doctor gives me, in case it matters later.

plain.li: I'm getting stronger every day.
Slow going, but I'm going.
My legs remember how to walk, mostly.
I'm sick of being careful.
Another week of taking it easy, they tell me.
[walking] Just to the end of the path and back.
[walking] One more lap, then I'll sit down.
[walking] The fresh air does more than any medicine.
[inbed] I've counted every crack in this ceiling.
[inbed] Let me up, I'm bored out of my mind.
[old] I don't mend the way I used to.
[child] Can I go out and play yet?
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] Give me something to do, anything at all.
[trait:Lazy] I could get used to all this lying about.
[winter] I'll be back on my feet before the thaw.

warm.li: Thank you for putting up with me while I mend.

blunt.li: I'm fine, stop asking.

cheerful.li: Look, I made it all the way here without stopping!

gloomy.li: I'll never be quite what I was.

cold.li: A few more days and I'll be back at full work.

plain.li: I've a lot on my mind lately.
Things are changing for me, slowly.
[story:GrudgingRespect,stage:0] {OTHER_nameDef} again, showing off at {SKILL}.
[story:GrudgingRespect,stage:0] I don't care how good {OTHER_nameDef} is, I'm better.
[story:GrudgingRespect,stage:1] I worked next to {OTHER_nameDef} all morning and neither of us said a word.
[story:GrudgingRespect,stage:1] {OTHER_nameDef} does neat work, I'll give {OTHER_objective} that.
[story:GrudgingRespect,stage:2] {OTHER_nameDef} and I have mostly stopped needling each other.
[story:OldWounds,stage:0] I can't sit at the same table as {OTHER_nameDef}.
[story:OldWounds,stage:0] Some things don't heal, and {OTHER_nameDef} knows what I mean.
[story:OldWounds,stage:1] {OTHER_nameDef} spoke to me today, first time in ages.
[story:OldWounds,stage:2] {OTHER_nameDef} is trying, and I'm trying to let {OTHER_objective}.
[story:OldDebt,stage:0] I still owe {OTHER_nameDef}, and I haven't forgotten.
[story:OldDebt,stage:1] I'm making something for {OTHER_nameDef}, so keep it to yourself.
[story:OldDebt,stage:2] It's nearly ready, the thing for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[story:SecondChances,stage:0] The council never listens, why would it start now?
[story:SecondChances,stage:0] I've stopped asking the council for anything.
[story:SecondChances,stage:1] Maybe the council does hear us, now and then.
[story:Masterwork,stage:0] I watch {OTHER_nameDef} work and try to remember every move.
[story:Masterwork,stage:1] {OTHER_nameDef} looked over my work and only frowned once.
[story:Masterwork,stage:2] This piece has to be the best thing I've ever made.
[story:Calling,stage:0] I want to learn {SKILL} properly.
[story:Calling,stage:0,child] When I grow up I'm doing {SKILL}, like {OTHER_nameDef}.
[story:Calling,stage:1] I've been following {OTHER_nameDef} around all week.
[story:Calling,stage:2] Practice, and then more practice.
[story:PassingItOn,stage:0] All I know about {SKILL} goes with me if I don't pass it on.
[story:PassingItOn,stage:1] {OTHER_nameDef} learns fast, faster than I did.
[story:PassingItOn,stage:2] A few last things to show {OTHER_nameDef}, then it's all {OTHER_possessive}.
[story:LongGrief,stage:0] {LOST}'s chair is still empty.
[story:LongGrief,stage:0] I keep turning to tell {LOST} things.
[story:LongGrief,stage:1] I told a story about {LOST} today and got all the way through it.
[story:LongGrief,stage:2] I ate a whole meal today and tasted it.
[story:SecretTold,stage:0] There's something I've never said out loud.
[story:SecretTold,stage:1] I nearly told {OTHER_nameDef} today.
[story:SecretTold,stage:2] I'm going to say it soon, before I lose my nerve.
[story:FearFaced,stage:0] I don't want to talk about it.
[story:FearFaced,stage:0,nemesis] I still see {NAME} when I close my eyes.
[story:FearFaced,stage:1] I've been getting ready, bit by bit.
[story:FearFaced,stage:2] I'm not running this time.
[story:RecurringDream,stage:0] The same dream again last night.
[story:RecurringDream,stage:0,nightmare] Sorry if I woke you, I was shouting again.
[story:RecurringDream,stage:1] I told {OTHER_nameDef} about the dream, and {OTHER_pronoun} didn't laugh.
[story:RecurringDream,stage:2] I'm going to make something out of that dream.
[story:GrudgeLaidDown,stage:0] I won't forgive {FACTION} for {LOST}, not ever.
[story:GrudgeLaidDown,stage:1] {OTHER_nameDef} says the anger is eating me up.
[story:GrudgeLaidDown,stage:2] I thought about {FACTION} today and my hands stayed still.
[story:WithinReach,stage:0] I'll never manage to {GOAL}, will I?
[story:WithinReach,stage:1] Maybe I can {GOAL} after all.
[story:LongWayHome,stage:1] It's good to be home, I've so much to tell.
[story:LongWayHome,stage:1] My own bed, at last.
[story:FindingHome,stage:0] I still don't know where anything's kept around here.
[story:FindingHome,stage:0] Everyone here knows each other but me.
[story:FindingHome,stage:1] I've a corner that feels like mine now.
[story:FindingHome,stage:2] I'm starting to think of this place as home.
[story:Companion,stage:0] Everywhere I go, {PET_nameDef} comes too.
[story:Companion,stage:1] I'm still working out what {PET_nameDef} wants from me.
[story:Companion,stage:2] I can tell {PET_nameDef} trusts me now.

warm.li: [story:OldWounds,stage:1] I'd like to put things right with {OTHER_nameDef}.
[story:FindingHome,stage:1] People here have been kinder than I expected.

blunt.li: [story:GrudgingRespect,stage:0] {OTHER_nameDef}, of all people.
[story:SecondChances,stage:0] The council can keep its promises.

cheerful.li: [story:Calling,stage:1] I'm going to be good at {SKILL}, just watch!
[story:Companion,stage:1] Guess who learned a new trick today, {PET_nameDef} did!

gloomy.li: [story:LongGrief,stage:0] It doesn't get easier, whatever they say.
[story:WithinReach,stage:0] Some things just aren't meant for me.

cold.li: [story:OldDebt,stage:0] A debt is a debt, and I pay mine.
[story:Masterwork,stage:2] It will be done properly, or not at all.

plain.li: Tomorrow's {NAME}, don't forget.
Is it {NAME} tomorrow already?
[way:feast] Tomorrow's {NAME}, so save some room.
[way:feast] I hope someone's started on the cooking for tomorrow.
[way:games] Games tomorrow, and I plan to win.
[way:rest] No work tomorrow, it's {NAME}.
[way:remembrance] Tomorrow's {NAME}.
[way:remembrance] I'll be thinking of them tomorrow.
[day:death,knew] Tomorrow's the day we lost {DEAD}.
[day:death,knew] I'll go and stand by {DEAD}'s grave tomorrow.
[day:birthday,mine] Tomorrow I'm a year older, so don't make a fuss.
[day:birthday,!mine] It's {OTHER_nameDef}'s birthday tomorrow, keep it quiet.
[day:birthday,!mine] Has anyone got something for {OTHER_nameDef} for tomorrow?
[day:arrival,mine] Tomorrow it'll be another year since I walked in here.
[day:arrival,!mine] Tomorrow's the day {OTHER_nameDef} turned up here, remember?
[day:wedding,mine] Our wedding day comes round again tomorrow.
[day:founding] Founding day tomorrow, and we're still here.
[day:harvest] Harvest day tomorrow, we've earned it.
[day:battle] Tomorrow's {NAME}, and I still remember the noise.
[day:holiday] Tomorrow's our own day, the one we picked ourselves.
[child] How many sleeps until {NAME}, just one?

warm.li: I'm glad we keep {NAME}, I'm looking forward to tomorrow.
[day:wedding,!mine] Tomorrow's {NAME}, let's make it nice for them.

blunt.li: Tomorrow's {NAME}, so finish your work today.

cheerful.li: It's {NAME} tomorrow, I can hardly wait!
[day:wedding,!mine] Tomorrow's {NAME}, those two will be unbearable!

cold.li: Tomorrow's {NAME}, plan the work around it.

plain.li: Not my day.
That one stung.
[setback:WorkTornDown] Days of work, torn down in an afternoon.
[setback:WorkTornDown] They pulled down what I built, just like that.
[setback:WorkWrecked] Look at it, all that work wrecked.
[setback:CropLost] My crop's gone, rotted where it stood.
[setback:CropLost] I planted that field with my own hands.
[setback:BotchedBuild] I botched it, and everyone can see.
[setback:ShoddyWork] That's not my best work, and it bothers me.
[setback:MakingDo] Making do again, with whatever's lying about.
[setback:BotchedSurgery] I keep seeing my hands slip.
[setback:LongHauls] My arms are a foot longer from all that hauling.
[setback:LongHauls] Why is the stockpile always on the far side?
[setback:LeftWaiting] I waited half the day for someone to look at this.
[setback:ColdMeal] Cold supper, outside, in this weather.
[setback:ArtSold] They sold my piece to a trader without asking me.
[setback:AnimalSold] They sold my animal, and I never got to say goodbye.
[setback:Outshone,about] {OTHER_nameDef} is better at my own craft than I am now.
[setback:DriftedApart,about] {OTHER_nameDef} and I used to talk every night.
[setback:NoisyNeighbour,about] {OTHER_nameDef} snores like a rockslide.
[setback:NoisyNeighbour] I didn't sleep a wink for the noise next door.
[setback:CookingCriticised] Next time they can cook their own supper.
[setback:Mocked] Laugh it up, I know who was laughing.
[setback:CreditTaken,about] {OTHER_nameDef} took the credit for my work.
[setback:ReturnedBroken] Lent it out and got it back in pieces.
[setback:SpoiltStores] Rot in the stores again, what a waste.
[setback:NoCoat] Soaked to the skin, and not a coat to my name.
[setback:UglyBedroom] My room's full of junk and I can't stand it.
[setback:IdeaPassedOver] The council turned my idea down without a second look.
[setback:OutVoted] The vote went the other way, fine.
[setback:FriendLetDown,about] The council let {OTHER_nameDef} down, and that's on all of us.
[setback:RivalHonoured,about] Of course they'd honor {OTHER_nameDef}, of course they would.
[setback:NotAgreed] That wasn't what I wanted, and they knew it.
[setback:ToldThemSo] I said it would go wrong, didn't I?
[setback:MissedGathering] I missed the whole gathering, stuck at work.
[setback:NoPlate] The food ran out before it got to me.
[setback:RainedOut] The rain spoiled the whole thing.
[setback:Homesick] I dreamt of home and woke up here.

warm.li: It's all right, I'll get over it.
[setback:CropLost] We'll plant again, there's seed left.

blunt.li: Don't ask.
[setback:WorkTornDown] Next time ask me before you tear it down.

cheerful.li: Ah well, I'll do better tomorrow!

gloomy.li: Why does it always happen to me?

cold.li: Noted, and it won't happen again.

plain.li: They gave me "{WISH}", then took it back.
I should have known "{WISH}" wouldn't last.
A promise is a promise, and they broke it.
[kept:ownroom] They put me back in with the others, after they promised.
[kept:room] My room's not what they said it would be any more.
[kept:bed] That bed was ours, and now it isn't.
[kept:thing] It was right there, and now it's gone.
[kept:stock] The shelves they filled for me are empty again.
[kept:assignment] They let me do the work I asked for, then changed it back.
[kept:pet] I'd only just learned all its little habits.
[kept:decree] They lifted the decree I asked for, before its time.

warm.li: I'm sure they had their reasons, but it still hurts.

blunt.li: Next time, don't promise.

cheerful.li: Well, it was nice while it lasted.

gloomy.li: That's what a promise is worth around here.

cold.li: I'll remember who gave their word.

plain.li: {ENEMY} is still out there somewhere.
I hear the name {ENEMY} and my hands go cold.
One day I'll meet {ENEMY} again.
[deed:maimed] Every time this scar aches, I think of {ENEMY}.
[deed:downed] {ENEMY} put me in the dirt and walked away.
[deed:hunts] {ENEMY} swore to hunt me down, and I believe it.
[deed:robbed] {ENEMY} won't forget what we took.
[deed:betrayed] I trusted {ENEMY} once.
[deed:enslaved] Some nights I still feel the chains {ENEMY} put on me.
[beast] That beast is still out in the hills, I know it.
[beast] I watch the tree line every time I go out.

warm.li: I'm not afraid of {ENEMY}, not with all of you here.

blunt.li: If {ENEMY} shows up again, I'm ready.

cheerful.li: Let {ENEMY} come back, I've been practicing!

gloomy.li: {ENEMY} will be back, that kind always comes back.

cold.li: Next time I see {ENEMY}, it ends.

plain.li: I keep picturing "{WISH}".
Still hoping for "{WISH}".
I wonder if anyone remembers "{WISH}".
One day, maybe, "{WISH}".
[promised] They promised me "{WISH}", and I'm counting on it.
[petition] A few of us are still waiting on "{WISH}".
[forother] I asked for "{WISH}", and it isn't even for me.
[repeat] I asked for "{WISH}" before, and I'll ask again.
[winter] This winter would be easier with "{WISH}".
[night] I lay awake thinking about "{WISH}" again.

warm.li: No hurry, but "{WISH}" would make me very happy.

blunt.li: Still no "{WISH}".

cheerful.li: Any day now, "{WISH}", I can feel it!

gloomy.li: So much for "{WISH}", it isn't going to happen.

cold.li: I'm keeping count of the days on "{WISH}".

plain.li: [younger] I've more grey than my own {RELATION}, and that's not how it's meant to go.
[younger] Most people never get to be older than their {RELATION}.
[younger] You slept through most of my life, {OTHER_nameDef}, but you're here now.
[younger,grand] Not many grandchildren get to tell their {RELATION} to slow down.
[younger,near] Some days I forget I've lived more years than my own {RELATION}.
[elder,near] I went into the pod with you still small, and look at you now.
[elder] I slept through most of your life, and I'm sorry for it.
[elder] I'm still your {RELATION}, whatever the years say.
[elder,grand] Not many get to meet a {RELATION} older than they are.
[elder] You've lived more years than I have, but I knew you first.

warm.li: [younger] Whatever the years say, it's good to have my {RELATION} here.
[elder] I'd have stayed awake for all of your life, if I could have.

blunt.li: [younger] My {RELATION} is younger than me, and I've stopped trying to make sense of it.
[elder] Don't call me old, I've lived fewer years than you.

cheerful.li: [younger] Sit down, {RELATION}, and let the old one fetch it for once.
[elder] Look at you, all grown up, and older than me too.

gloomy.li: [younger] You slept, and the rest of us got old without you.
[elder] I closed my eyes in the pod and woke up to a family of strangers.

cold.li: [younger] The pods kept your years and spent mine.
[elder] Years asleep are years nobody gets back.
